name: handoff
description: /handoff summarizes the session into a prompt a fresh session can pick up and saves it as a Markdown file under ~/.claude/handoffs/<project>/; new continues it in a fresh session; save only saves it; each saves one per suggested plan; list and resume [id] [extra context] revisit this project's handoffs; open shows every handoff in a local web viewer; new, save and resume with nothing after them open a box for notes, and resume's box lists the handoffs to pick from

writer.title: Recap writer
writer.description: Who writes the recap. subagent (the default) starts a Haiku subagent, which also works behind an API proxy that refuses background requests. haiku asks Haiku in the background first and starts the subagent when the API refuses. conversation has the session's own model write the recap as a normal turn.
